name: How do I choose the right contractor for restoration remodeling?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right contractor for restoration remodeling?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choose a contractor who possesses hands-on expertise across both structural repair and finish trades, including custom framing, drywall, and tile installation. A practical decision factor is ensuring they can serve as a single point of contact. An owner-operated general contractor who oversees the site directly and coordinates necessary sub-trades for plumbing and electrical will ensure work aligns smoothly. Always verify licensing, insurance, and third-party credentials like an A+ Better Business Bureau rating.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for an experienced, licensed contractor skilled in both structural framing and finish work who directly oversees the jobsite and manages trade specialists.
